dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the point of maximum lateral width at the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minimal; lateral margins exhibit a smooth, slightly asymmetrical convex curvature with no pronounced localized indentations or bulges.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Pale grey to off-white; median pixel intensity is high-key, lighter than slate-grey but not yet pure mature white.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low frequency; surface is largely uniform with subtle, diffuse darker shading near the anterior and posterior extremities but no distinct dark-pixel clusters.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradient transitions between tonal variations across the visible epidermis are smooth rather than sharp.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, high-contrast white linear marks (rake marks) oriented longitudinally. One distinct, small, bright-white circular mark is visible on the right lateral-dorsal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous healed linear rake marks/scratches across the central and lateral dorsal planes.
other_distinctive_markers: Centrally aligned, dark circular blowhole aperture clearly visible at the anterior-most point of the dorsal surface.
